name: Free Pascal compile
description: Compile or syntax-check one Pascal program or unit (.pas, .pp, .lpr) with the Free Pascal compiler. The messages, with file and line, are saved as a text file with a final '[exit code N]' line, so a failed compile still gives you the errors. Nothing is left behind: units and objects go to a scratch folder.

presets.label: Check (compile, no linking, nothing kept)
presets.description: Compile without linking (fpc -Cn) into a scratch folder: finds every syntax and type error, keeps nothing
presets.command: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); fpc -Cn -vewnh -FU"$d" -FE"$d" "$1" > "$2" 2>&1; echo "[exit code $?]" >> "$2"; rm -rf "$d"; true' fpc {INPUT} {OUTPUT}

presets.label: Compile (errors, warnings, hints)
presets.description: fpc -vewnh -O2 into a scratch folder; the program or unit is not kept, the messages are
presets.command: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); fpc -vewnh -O2 -FU"$d" -FE"$d" "$1" > "$2" 2>&1; echo "[exit code $?]" >> "$2"; rm -rf "$d"; true' fpc {INPUT} {OUTPUT}
